title: Our driver Jose made the...
text: Our driver Jose made the experience so memorable and easy. He was so knowledgeable and gave excellent recommendations. I give him 5 out of 5 stars
author: Leonora_F

title: Beautiful day
text: This was a wonderful way for us to see the mountains and coast of Spain. Our driver/ guide Jose was fantastic!!! He accommodated us in terms of our interests and knew Frigliana very well and made a great recommendation for lunch in Nerja. The caves are fascinating and awe inspiring
author: Felicity_M

title: Great tour!
text: Jose was fantastic! I loved the tour. Nerja & Frigiliana are beautiful.  Plenty of time in each location.
author: Liana_B

title: Explore outside of Granada
text: José was our tour guide and did an excellent job of explaining the agriculture of the region, some of the history, and guiding us around Frigiliana and Nerja. He got us to the Nerja cave first thing which was crucial as the line was incredibly long when we were on our way out. He gave excellent suggestions for the beach at Nerja as well. We had a fabulous day exploring!
author: 938blancaa

title: This was an amazing day....
text: This was an amazing day. José was a fantastic guide who made the day very very special. Thank you José. We were three people plus José. I appreciate the hospitality shown by José and my fellow travelers. Great day had by all.
author: Anne_D

title: We had some flexibility...
text: We had some flexibility because it was a small group, which was nice. It’s a nice day trip from Granada if you have time, but I would not consider it a must-do if you are short on time in Granada.
author: Jessica_A

title: Great experience
text: Driver was awesome. Amount of time at locations was more then enough. Scenery was spectacular.......
author: Samuel_S

title: Beautiful day trip
text:
Had a fantastic tour to Nerja and Frigiliana! Everything was very well organized from start to finish, making the day smooth and enjoyable.

Jose was an excellent guide—friendly, knowledgeable, and always making sure everyone was comfortable. He shared great insights about the area that really brought the experience to life.

Highly recommend this tour if you want an easy, informative, and enjoyable way to explore these beautiful towns!
author: Emma_S

title: Perfect trip to the coast
text: This was a delightful day from start to finish. Our driver, Gonzalo, was great...very informative, helpful and friendly. Our grandchildren loved him. Everything was better than we could hope for.
author: Scott_S

title: 5 START experience - highly recommended
text:
The tour was fantastic - Nerja cave, Frigiliana and Balcony of Europe all were amazing places by themselves, but the 5 star is also for:
1. They have only us (2 people) booked on that day - at first they tried to re-schedule but could not since our schedule was very tight. Despite that, they did not cancel the tour and we got a private tour - this is 5 start customer obsession!
2. Out guide Jose was knowledgeable, kind and experienced - he explained things pretty well and went above and beyond by extending it for more time on our request without hesitation - can not ask for more!
author: somanko
